registers.desc: Flag Register. Holds status bits for the periodic time update, countdown timer, alarm, external event and low-voltage detections. May be written at any time to clear status flags.

fields.name: UF
fields.desc: Periodic Time Update Flag. Write 0 to clear. If set to 0 beforehand, 1 indicates the occurrence of a Periodic Time Update Interrupt event.

fields.name: TF
fields.desc: Periodic Countdown Timer Flag. Write 0 to clear. If set to 0 beforehand, 1 indicates the occurrence of a Periodic Countdown Timer Interrupt event.

fields.name: AF
fields.desc: Alarm Flag. Write 0 to clear. If set to 0 beforehand, 1 indicates the occurrence of an Alarm Interrupt event.

fields.name: EVF
fields.desc: External Event Flag. Write 0 to clear. If set to 0 beforehand, 1 indicates the occurrence of an External Event. The POR value depends on the EVI pin level (1 if a LOW level was detected, 0 otherwise).

fields.name: V2F
fields.desc: Voltage Low Flag 2. Read 1 if the voltage crossed V_LOW2 and the data in the device are no longer valid (all registers must be initialized). Cleared by writing 0; automatically set to 1 at power on reset. Writing 0 also clears V1F.

fields.name: V1F
fields.desc: Voltage Low Flag 1. Read 1 if the voltage crossed V_LOW1 and temperature compensation is stopped. Cleared by writing 0; automatically set to 1 at power on reset. Writing 0 also clears V2F.

fields.desc: Captured value of the 100th Seconds register, coded in BCD format (00 to 99). Cleared to 00 when ERST = 1 and an External Event is detected on the EVI pin.

registers.desc: Offset Register. Holds the OFFSET value used for aging correction.
registers.name: OFFSET_REGISTER

fields.name: OFFSET
fields.desc: Amount of the effective frequency offset. Two's complement number with a range of -32 to +31 adjustment steps (maximum correction range roughly +/-7.4 ppm). One LSB corresponds to 1/(32768*128) = 0.2384 ppm.

registers.desc: Event Control register. Controls event detection on the EVI pin, including edge polarity, digital glitch filtering and time-stamp capture.
registers.name: EVENT_CONTROL

fields.name: ECP
fields.desc: Event Capture Enable (Time Stamp Enable). 0: disabled (default). 1: an External Event on the EVI pin captures the Seconds and 100th Seconds into the CP registers.

enum_values.name: EVENT_CAPTURE_DISABLED
enum_values.desc: Disables the Event Capture. Default value.

enum_values.name: EVENT_CAPTURE_ENABLED
enum_values.desc: An External Event on EVI captures Seconds and 100th Seconds.

fields.name: EHL
fields.desc: Event High/Low detection Select. 0: the Low level (negative edge) is the External Event (default). 1: the High level (positive edge) is the External Event.

enum_values.name: LOW_LEVEL_EVENT
enum_values.desc: Low level (negative edge) is regarded as the External Event. Default value.

enum_values.name: HIGH_LEVEL_EVENT
enum_values.desc: High level (positive edge) is regarded as the External Event.

fields.name: ET
fields.desc: Event Filtering Time set. Applies digital filtering to the EVI pin by sampling the signal. 00: no filtering (default), minimal pulse time 30.5 us. 01: 3.9 ms. 10: 15.6 ms. 11: 125 ms.

enum_values.name: NO_FILTER
enum_values.desc: No filtering; edge detection with minimal pulse time 30.5 us. Default value.

fields.name: ERST
fields.desc: Event Reset. Used for a hardware-based time adjustment (synchronizing). 0: no reset on External Event (default). 1: on an External Event the 100th Seconds register and the 100th Seconds CP and Seconds CP registers are reset to 0; ERST is then automatically reset to 0.

enum_values.name: NO_RESET
enum_values.desc: No reset if an External Event is detected. Default value.

enum_values.name: RESET_ON_EVENT
enum_values.desc: Resets the 100th Seconds and CP registers when an External Event is detected.
